D5/S3/Quantum/FiniteDimensional.bornProb.name: D5.S3.Quantum.FiniteDimensional.bornProbability
D5/S3/Quantum/FiniteDimensional.bornProb.signature: noncomputable def bornProbability {n : Type*} [Fintype n] (rho P : Matrix n n ℂ) : ℂ

D5/S3/Quantum/FiniteDimensional.born_pro.name: D5.S3.Quantum.FiniteDimensional.born_probability_skeleton
D5/S3/Quantum/FiniteDimensional.born_pro.signature: theorem born_probability_skeleton {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (rho : Matrix n n ℂ) (hRho : rho.PosSemidef) (hTrace : Matrix.trace rho = 1) : bornProbability rho (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 ∧ (∀ P Q : Matrix n n ℂ, bornProbability rho (P + Q) = bornProbability rho P + bornProbability rho Q) ∧ ∀ P : Matrix n n ℂ, star P = P → P * P = P → 0 ≤ bornProbability rho P

D5/S3/Quantum/FiniteDimensional.qubit_we.name: D5.S3.Quantum.FiniteDimensional.qubit_weyl_star
D5/S3/Quantum/FiniteDimensional.qubit_we.signature: theorem qubit_weyl_star : qubitZ * qubitX = -(qubitX * qubitZ) ∧ star qubitX = qubitX ∧ star qubitZ = qubitZ ∧ qubitX ^ 2 = 1 ∧ qubitZ ^ 2 = 1
